test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I dream of a country where even the least talented person has the ______ to earn a living.
solution:
The correct answer is '**opportunity**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "opportunity" fits perfectly in the context as it refers to the chance or possibility to do something. In this case, it implies the chance for everyone, regardless of talent, to earn a living.
 
• "Landmark" refers to an important feature or event, which does not fit the context of earning a living.
 
• "Priority" refers to something being more important than other things, which is not applicable to the context of earning a living.
 
• "Admit" means to allow entry, but it does not make sense in the context of earning a living.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *"I dream of a country where even the least talented person has the opportunity__ to earn a living."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Landmark (स्मारक)**: refers to an important feature or event, which is not applicable here.
 
• **Priority (प्राथमिकता)**: means giving something more importance, which does not fit the sentence context of earning a living.
 
• **Admit (स्वीकार करना)**: refers to allowing someone entry, which is irrelevant in this context.
